descriptions.normal: An exceedingly sumptuous pizza. First lay out a base of ham, then add in meat that has been chopped up into little bits for a dish that packs an unrivaled sense of satisfaction. Once roasted, the char of meat and the creamy flavor of the cheese are truly a tantalizing combination.
descriptions.suspicious: An exceedingly sumptuous pizza. If one ignores the grease for a moment, the cold meat chunks can still be forced down, but the stale pastry poses quite the challenge nonetheless... With how hard it is, perhaps you could lay a hilichurl out with it?
descriptions.delicious: An exceedingly sumptuous pizza. Amidst the heat that rises as it freshly exits the oven, give the crisp edges a gentle pull — a veritable waterfall of cheese gushes forth, wrapped up in the dense aroma of meat that satisfies the taste buds and gives a wondrous, hearty sense of fullness.

effectTexts.normal: Increases all party members' Physical DMG by 35% and CRIT Rate by 8% for 300s.
effectTexts.suspicious: Increases all party members' Physical DMG by 25% and CRIT Rate by 6% for 300s.
effectTexts.delicious: Increases all party members' Physical DMG by 45% and CRIT Rate by 10% for 300s.
